parts.text: As a dispatcher, I plan and run the flights by deciding which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off a flight before it leaves. I can also call off a flight, and I share airspace information because it comes from the authorities and is the same for everyone. Since several dispatchers plan at the same time for the same busy sites and popular drones, the service needs to help us find out which of our drones could get to where a job starts.
